summary.text: Jake Hunsaker is the Republican candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 48, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Democrat Benyde Walker.
He won the Republican primary on June 23, 2026, defeating Nik Anderson, and previously ran for U.S. House in Utah's 4th District in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Hunsaker sought the Republican nomination for U.S. House in Utah's 4th Congressional District in 2022 and lost to incumbent Burgess Owens in the primary, 61.9 percent to 38.1 percent.
According to Ballotpedia, his 2022 campaign website listed upholding the Constitution, fiscal responsibility with incremental budget reductions, and free trade among his priorities.
